```{r load_data}
library(data.table)
# Load processed genotypes
Processed_Genotypes<-data.table::fread("Processed_variant_genotypes_simplified.txt")

# remove sex chromosomes
nrow(Processed_Genotypes)
Processed_Genotypes<-subset(Processed_Genotypes, CHROM!="chrY" & CHROM!="chrX" & CHROM!="CHROM")
nrow(Processed_Genotypes)
```

```{r count number of loci per chromosome, include=TRUE}
table(Processed_Genotypes$CHROM)
```

```{r generate basic stats for processed genotypes, include=TRUE}
# Generate basic stats for processed genotypes
## Number of loci
NumberTotal<-nrow(Processed_Genotypes)

## Number of loci where in Unique_Genotypes there is a "." genotype, indicating missing data
### The Unique_Genotypes values are , delimited genotypes e.g. .,0,1,2 is four genotypes, the first one missing data
NumberMissing<-sum(grepl("\\.", Processed_Genotypes$Unique_Genotypes))

## Total number of loci per chromosome
Processed_Genotypes %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(Numberloci=n()) -> lociPerChromosome

## Number of missing data loci per chromosome
Processed_Genotypes %>% filter(grepl("\\.", Unique_Genotypes)) %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(NumberMissing=n()) -> MissingPerChromosome

# make sure every chromosome is represented in the MissingPerChromosome dataframe, if a chromosome is missing, add a row with 0 missing loci for that chromosome
all_chromosomes<-unique(Processed_Genotypes$CHROM)
for (chrom in all_chromosomes) {
  if (!(chrom %in% MissingPerChromosome$CHROM)) {
    MissingPerChromosome<-rbind(MissingPerChromosome, data.frame(CHROM=chrom, NumberMissing=0))
  }
}

## Merge the two dataframes
lociPerChromosome<-merge(lociPerChromosome, MissingPerChromosome, by="CHROM", all.x=TRUE)
lociPerChromosome$NumberMissing[is.na(lociPerChromosome$NumberMissing)]<-0

## Calculate non-missing data loci
lociPerChromosome$NumberNonMissing<-lociPerChromosome$Numberloci-lociPerChromosome$NumberMissing

## Make long format for plotting, combine missing and non-missing number values
gather(lociPerChromosome, key="Type", value="Number", NumberMissing:NumberNonMissing) -> lociPerChromosome_Long
### Change "NumberMissing" to "Missing" and "NumberNonMissing" to "None Missing"
lociPerChromosome_Long$Type<-gsub("Number", "", lociPerChromosome_Long$Type)
lociPerChromosome_Long$Type<-gsub("NonMissing", "None Missing", lociPerChromosome_Long$Type)

## Sort chromosomes as factors chr1, chr2, chr3, ... chr19
lociPerChromosome_Long$CHROM<-factor(lociPerChromosome_Long$CHROM, levels=paste0("chr", c(1:19)))

## Plot as stacked bar plot
ggplot(lociPerChromosome_Long, aes(x=CHROM, y=Number/1000000, fill=Type))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#f04857", "#2d5879"))+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))+
  labs(title="Number of loci per chromosome", x="Chromosome", y="Number of loci (M)", fill="")+
  theme(legend.position="bottom")+
  CS.THEME+
  # make y axis labels with commas
  # fill space below the bars
  scale_y_continuous(labels=comma, expand=c(0,0.1))
```

```{r generate RI only bins}
# Define bin size (in base pairs)
bin_size <- 1000000  # 1 Mb bins

# Create a new column for bin assignment
Processed_Genotypes$Bin <- floor(as.numeric(Processed_Genotypes$POS) / bin_size) * bin_size

# Summarize RI-only genotype counts per bin
RI_only_bins <- Processed_Genotypes %>%
  filter(RI_Only > 0) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_RI_Only_Loci = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Ensure correct ordering of chromosomes for plotting
RI_only_bins$CHROM <- factor(RI_only_bins$CHROM, levels=paste0("chr", c(1:19)))

# Import chromosome lengths to make sure to plot full chromosomes
chrom_lengths <- read.delim(file.path(COLCROSS_ROOT, "assembly_lengths_for_75_RI_and_founders/all_strains_chromosome_lengths.tsv"), header = FALSE, sep = "\t")
colnames(chrom_lengths) <- c("Assembly","CHROM", "LENGTH")

# Filter to only include the GRCm39 assembly
chrom_lengths<-subset(chrom_lengths, Assembly=="GRCm38.p6.renamed.filtered.fa")
# drop sex chromosomes and chrM
chrom_lengths<-subset(chrom_lengths, CHROM!="chrY" & CHROM!="chrX" & CHROM!="chrM")

# For each chromosome, add a row with the last bin to ensure full chromosome is plotted. Where the last bin is the chromosome length
chrom_lengths %>% mutate(Bin = LENGTH - LENGTH %% bin_size) -> last_bin_per_chrom

# Add the last bin to the RI_only_bins dataframe
RI_only_bins %>% bind_rows(last_bin_per_chrom) -> RI_only_bins

# Make CHROM a factor sorted by chromosome number
RI_only_bins$CHROM <- factor(RI_only_bins$CHROM, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19)))
```

```{r plot heatmap of RI only bins}
# Plot binned RI-only loci along the genome as heatmap
ggplot(RI_only_bins, aes(x = Bin/1000000, y = CHROM, fill = Number_of_RI_Only_Loci )) +
  geom_tile() +
  # Set the colour scale to viridis, with the "magma" option, and set the na.value to grey90, and the begin and end to 0 and 0.7, and make the scale fill log10 transformed
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", na.value = "grey70", begin=0.3, end=0, trans="log10", labels=comma) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Number of RI-only loci") +
  theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill="white"),
  panel.grid.major=element_blank(), #adds major grid lines
  panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), #adds minor grid lines	
  panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=1.5, linetype="solid"), #draws a black border around plot
  axis.line=element_blank()
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  # Set background to grey
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey70"))+
  # Facet wrap by chromosome with free scales and not labels, make facet labels bold
  facet_wrap(~CHROM, scales = "free", ncol = 5)+
  # Remove y axis labels
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  # make x axis have minor ticks
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 200, 20), minor_breaks = seq(0, 200, 1))+
  # make legend wider
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"))+
  # remove the little minor white lines in the background
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())->RI_only_bins_heatmap

# Save the plot
ggsave("RI_only_bins_heatmap.png", RI_only_bins_heatmap, width=26, height=4.1, dpi=600)

# Save Robject
saveRDS(RI_only_bins_heatmap, "RI_only_bins_heatmap.rds")
```

```{r generate Founder only bins}
# Summarize Founder-only genotype counts per bin
Founder_only_bins <- Processed_Genotypes %>%
  filter(Founder_Strain_Only > 0) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Add the last bin to the Founder_only_bins dataframe
Founder_only_bins %>% bind_rows(last_bin_per_chrom) -> Founder_only_bins

# Add an entry for each chromosome at the start of the chromosome to ensure full chromosome is plotted
Founder_only_bins %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(Bin = 0) -> first_bin_per_chrom

# Add the first bin to the Founder_only_bins dataframe
Founder_only_bins %>% bind_rows(first_bin_per_chrom) -> Founder_only_bins

# Ensure correct ordering of chromosomes for plotting
Founder_only_bins$CHROM <- factor(Founder_only_bins$CHROM, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y")))

# Filter to exclude the Y chromosome and chrM
Founder_only_bins %>% filter(CHROM != "chrY" & CHROM != "chrM") -> Founder_only_bins
```

```{r build shuffles}
generate_shuffle_indices <- function(df, chromosome_id, n_shuffles, seed) {
  
  if (!("CHROM" %in% colnames(df))) {
    stop("Input data frame must contain a column named 'CHROM'.")
  }
  
  if (!("originating_index" %in% colnames(df))) {
    stop("Input data frame must contain a column named 'originating_index'.")
  }
  
  if (!is.numeric(n_shuffles) || length(n_shuffles) != 1 || n_shuffles < 1) {
    stop("n_shuffles must be a single integer >= 1.")
  }
  
  if (!is.numeric(seed) || length(seed) != 1) {
    stop("seed must be a single numeric value.")
  }
  
  n_shuffles <- as.integer(n_shuffles)
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  chr_indices <- df$originating_index[df$CHROM == chromosome_id]
  
  if (length(chr_indices) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No rows found for chromosome:", chromosome_id))
  }
  
  shuffle_mat <- replicate(
    n = n_shuffles,
    expr = sample(chr_indices, size = length(chr_indices), replace = FALSE)
  )
  
  shuffle_df <- data.frame(
    originating_index = chr_indices,
    shuffle_mat,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  colnames(shuffle_df) <- c(
    "originating_index",
    paste0("shuffle_", seq_len(n_shuffles))
  )
  
  return(shuffle_df)
}

Processed_Genotypes$originating_index <- seq_len(nrow(Processed_Genotypes))

lapply(
  paste0("chr",c(1:19)),
  function(CHR) generate_shuffle_indices(
      df = Processed_Genotypes,
      chromosome_id = CHR,
      n_shuffles = 10,
      seed = 12345
    )
  ) %>% bind_rows() -> shuffle_indices_df

# I wanted to add the shuffled indices back to Processed_Genotypes using originating_index as the key. But this requires too much memory.
# So I will have to work with shuffle_indices_df and Processed_Genotypes beign seperate objects
```

  group_by(CHROM, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci = n(), .groups = "drop") -> Founder_only_bins_null__5

cbind(Processed_Genotypes[,c(1:2,20)],Processed_Genotypes[shuffle_indices_df[,7],16]) %>%
  filter(Founder_Strain_Only > 0) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci = n(), .groups = "drop") -> Founder_only_bins_null__6

cbind(Processed_Genotypes[,c(1:2,20)],Processed_Genotypes[shuffle_indices_df[,8],16]) %>%
  filter(Founder_Strain_Only > 0) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci = n(), .groups = "drop") -> Founder_only_bins_null__7

cbind(Processed_Genotypes[,c(1:2,20)],Processed_Genotypes[shuffle_indices_df[,9],16]) %>%
  filter(Founder_Strain_Only > 0) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci = n(), .groups = "drop") -> Founder_only_bins_null__8

cbind(Processed_Genotypes[,c(1:2,20)],Processed_Genotypes[shuffle_indices_df[,10],16]) %>%
  filter(Founder_Strain_Only > 0) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci = n(), .groups = "drop") -> Founder_only_bins_null__9

cbind(Processed_Genotypes[,c(1:2,20)],Processed_Genotypes[shuffle_indices_df[,11],16]) %>%
  filter(Founder_Strain_Only > 0) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci = n(), .groups = "drop") -> Founder_only_bins_null__10

Founder_only_bins_null__1$iteration<-1
Founder_only_bins_null__2$iteration<-2
Founder_only_bins_null__3$iteration<-3
Founder_only_bins_null__4$iteration<-4
Founder_only_bins_null__5$iteration<-5
Founder_only_bins_null__6$iteration<-6
Founder_only_bins_null__7$iteration<-7
Founder_only_bins_null__8$iteration<-8
Founder_only_bins_null__9$iteration<-9
Founder_only_bins_null__10$iteration<-10

# merge the null Founder only bins into one dataframe
Founder_only_bins_null <- bind_rows(Founder_only_bins_null__1, Founder_only_bins_null__2, Founder_only_bins_null__3, Founder_only_bins_null__4, Founder_only_bins_null__5, Founder_only_bins_null__6, Founder_only_bins_null__7, Founder_only_bins_null__8, Founder_only_bins_null__9, Founder_only_bins_null__10)

ggplot(Founder_only_bins_null, aes(x=Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth=1, fill="#2d5879", color="black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1500, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange", linewidth = 0.5, alpha=1) +
  ggtitle("Null distribution of Founder only bins")

ggplot(Founder_only_bins, aes(x=Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth=1, fill="#2d5879", color="black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1500, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange", linewidth = 0.5, alpha=1) +
  ggtitle("Observed distribution of Founder only bins")


# build ecdf of null Founder only bins
ecdf(Founder_only_bins_null$Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci) -> Founder_only_bins_null_ecdf

# estimate pvalue of observed Founder only bins using the null ecdf
Founder_only_bins$pvalue <- 1 - Founder_only_bins_null_ecdf(Founder_only_bins$Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci)

# perform multiple testing correction using the Benjamini-Hochberg method
Founder_only_bins$padj <- p.adjust(Founder_only_bins$pvalue, method = "BH")

# Save the Founder only bins with pvalues and adjusted pvalues
write.table(Founder_only_bins, "Founder_only_bins_with_pvalues.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

```{r plot heatmap of Founder only bins}
# Plot binned Founder-only loci along the genome as heatmap
ggplot(Founder_only_bins, aes(x = Bin/1000000, y = CHROM, fill = Number_of_Founder_Only_Loci )) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", na.value = "grey70", begin=0.3, end=0, trans="log10", labels=comma) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Number of Founder-only loci") +
  theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill="white"),
  panel.grid.major=element_blank(), #adds major grid lines
  panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), #adds minor grid lines	
  panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=1.5, linetype="solid"), #draws a black border around plot
  axis.line=element_blank()
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  # Set background to grey
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey70"))+
  # Facet wrap by chromosome with free scales and not labels, make facet labels bold
  facet_wrap(~CHROM, scales = "free", ncol = 5)+
  # Remove y axis labels
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  # make x axis have minor ticks
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 200, 20), minor_breaks = seq(0, 200, 1))+
  # make legend wider
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"))+
  # remove the little minor white lines in the background
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())->Founder_only_bins_heatmap

# Save the plot
ggsave("Founder_only_bins_heatmap.png", Founder_only_bins_heatmap, width=26, height=4.1, dpi=600)

# Save Robject
saveRDS(Founder_only_bins_heatmap, "Founder_only_bins_heatmap.rds")
```

```{r proces missing data loci for stacked barpot, include=TRUE}
nrow(Processed_Genotypes) -> NumberTotalLoci
# Total number of loci per chromosome
Processed_Genotypes %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(Numberloci=n()) -> lociPerChromosome

# Total number of missing loci per chromosome
Processed_Genotypes_Missing %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(NumberMissing=n()) -> MissingPerChromosome

# Total number of loci agnostic of population
nrow(subset(Processed_Genotypes_Missing, MissingFounderCount>0 | MissingRICount>0))

# Percentage of missing data agnostic of population
100*nrow(subset(Processed_Genotypes_Missing, MissingFounderCount>0 | MissingRICount>0))/NumberTotalLoci
NumberTotalLoci

# Total missing from founders
subset(Processed_Genotypes_Missing, MissingFounderCount>0) %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(NumberMissingFounder=n()) -> MissingFounderPerChromosome

# Total missing from RI
subset(Processed_Genotypes_Missing, MissingRICount>0) %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(NumberMissingRI=n()) -> MissingRIPerChromosome

# merge the dataframes
lociPerChromosome<-merge(lociPerChromosome, MissingFounderPerChromosome, by="CHROM", all.x=TRUE)
lociPerChromosome<-merge(lociPerChromosome, MissingRIPerChromosome, by="CHROM", all.x=TRUE)

# Calculate percentage of missing data for founders and RI
lociPerChromosome$PercentageMissingFounder<-lociPerChromosome$NumberMissingFounder/lociPerChromosome$Numberloci*100
lociPerChromosome$PercentageMissingRI<-lociPerChromosome$NumberMissingRI/lociPerChromosome$Numberloci*100

# make wide to long
gather(lociPerChromosome[,c(1,3,5)], key="Type", value="Number", NumberMissingFounder:PercentageMissingFounder) -> lociPerChromosome_Long_founder
gather(lociPerChromosome[,c(1,4,6)], key="Type", value="Number", NumberMissingRI:PercentageMissingRI) -> lociPerChromosome_Long_RI

# bind the two dataframes
bind_rows(lociPerChromosome_Long_founder, lociPerChromosome_Long_RI) -> lociPerChromosome_Long

# Add Population column
lociPerChromosome_Long$Population<-c(rep("Founder", nrow(lociPerChromosome_Long_founder)), rep("RI", nrow(lociPerChromosome_Long_RI)))

# Rename the Type column to "Number of loci" and "Percentage missing"
## replace "PercentageMissingFounder" with "Percentage_missing" and "PercentageMissingRI" with "Percentage_missing"
lociPerChromosome_Long$Type<-gsub("PercentageMissingFounder", "Percentage_missing", lociPerChromosome_Long$Type)
lociPerChromosome_Long$Type<-gsub("PercentageMissingRI", "Percentage_missing", lociPerChromosome_Long$Type)
## replace "NumberMissingFounder" with "Number_missing" and "NumberMissingRI" with "Number_missing"
lociPerChromosome_Long$Type<-gsub("NumberMissingFounder", "Number_missing", lociPerChromosome_Long$Type)
lociPerChromosome_Long$Type<-gsub("NumberMissingRI", "Number_missing", lociPerChromosome_Long$Type)

# make long to wide splitting by Type
spread(lociPerChromosome_Long, key="Type", value="Number") -> lociPerChromosome_Long

# Order chromosomes as factors chr1, chr2, chr3, ..., chrX
lociPerChromosome_Long$CHROM<-factor(lociPerChromosome_Long$CHROM, levels=paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y")))
lociPerChromosome_Long$Population<-factor(lociPerChromosome_Long$Population, levels=c("Founder", "RI"))
```

```{r generate Founder missingness bins}
# Define bin size (in base pairs)
bin_size <- 1000000  # 1 Mb bins

# Create a new column for bin assignment
Processed_Genotypes_Missing$Bin <- floor(Processed_Genotypes_Missing$POS / bin_size) * bin_size

# Summarize Founder missing genotype counts per bin
Founder_missing_bins <- Processed_Genotypes_Missing %>%
  group_by(CHROM, Bin) %>%
  summarise(Number_of_Founder_Missing_Loci = sum(MissingFounderCount), .groups = "drop")

# Remove sex chromosomes and chrM for plotting
Founder_missing_bins <- Founder_missing_bins %>% filter(CHROM != "chrY" & CHROM != "chrX" & CHROM != "chrM")

# Ensure correct ordering of chromosomes for plotting
Founder_missing_bins$CHROM <- factor(Founder_missing_bins$CHROM, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19)))

# Import chromosome lengths to make sure to plot full chromosomes
chrom_lengths <- read.delim(file.path(COLCROSS_ROOT, "assembly_lengths_for_75_RI_and_founders/all_strains_chromosome_lengths.tsv"), header = FALSE, sep = "\t")

# Remove sex chromosomes and chrM from chrom_lengths
chrom_lengths <- chrom_lengths %>% filter(V2 != "chrY" & V2 != "chrX" & V2 != "chrM")

# Filter to only include the GRCm39 assembly
chrom_lengths<-subset(chrom_lengths, V1=="GRCm39.renamed.filtered.fa")

# For each chromosome, add a row with the last bin to ensure full chromosome is plotted. Where the last bin is the chromosome length
chrom_lengths %>% mutate(Bin = V3 - V3 %% bin_size) -> last_bin_per_chrom

# rename columns
colnames(last_bin_per_chrom)[2]<-"CHROM"
colnames(last_bin_per_chrom)[3]<-"Chromosome_Length"

# Add the last bin to the Founder_missing_bins dataframe
Founder_missing_bins %>% bind_rows(last_bin_per_chrom) -> Founder_missing_bins

# Add an entry for each chromosome at the start of the chromosome to ensure full chromosome is plotted
Founder_missing_bins %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(Bin = 0) -> first_bin_per_chrom

# Add the first bin to the Founder_missing_bins dataframe
Founder_missing_bins %>% bind_rows(first_bin_per_chrom) -> Founder_missing_bins

# Make CHROM a factor sorted by chromosome number
Founder_missing_bins$CHROM <- factor(Founder_missing_bins$CHROM, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19)))

# Replace NA values in Number_of_Founder_Missing_Loci with 0
Founder_missing_bins$Number_of_Founder_Missing_Loci[is.na(Founder_missing_bins$Number_of_Founder_Missing_Loci)] <- 0

```

```{r plot heatmap of Founder missingness bins}
# Plot binned Founder missing loci along the genome as heatmap
ggplot(Founder_missing_bins, aes(x = 1+Bin/1000000, y = CHROM, fill = Number_of_Founder_Missing_Loci )) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "black", begin=0, end=0.7, trans="log10", labels=comma) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Position (Mb)", y = NULL, fill = "# Founder missing loci") +
  theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill="grey90"),
  panel.grid.major=element_blank(), #adds major grid lines
  panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), #adds minor grid lines
  panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=1.5, linetype="solid"), #draws a black border around plot
  axis.line=element_blank(),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10)
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  # Set background to grey
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"))+
  # Facet wrap by chromosome with free scales and not labels, make facet labels bold
  facet_wrap(~CHROM, scales = "free", ncol = 2, dir = "v")+
  # remove the little minor white lines in the background
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.025, "in")
  )+
  # make x axis have minor ticks
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 200, 20), minor_breaks = seq(0, 200, 1), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0))+
  # make legend wider
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(0.15, "in"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.1, "in")
    )->Founder_missing_bins_heatmap

Founder_missing_bins_heatmap

# Save the plot
ggsave("Founder_missing_bins_heatmap.png", Founder_missing_bins_heatmap, width=3.98, height=5, dpi=600)

# Save Robject
saveRDS(Founder_missing_bins_heatmap, "Founder_missing_bins_heatmap.rds")

chrom_lengths <- chrom_lengths %>% filter(V2 != "chrY" & V2 != "chrX" & V2 != "chrM")

# Filter to only include the GRCm39 assembly
chrom_lengths<-subset(chrom_lengths, V1=="GRCm39.renamed.filtered.fa")

# For each chromosome, add a row with the last bin to ensure full chromosome is plotted. Where the last bin is the chromosome length
chrom_lengths %>% mutate(Bin = V3 - V3 %% bin_size) -> last_bin_per_chrom

# Add the last bin to the RI_missing_bins dataframe
RI_missing_bins %>% bind_rows(last_bin_per_chrom) -> RI_missing_bins

# Add an entry for each chromosome at the start of the chromosome to ensure full chromosome is plotted
RI_missing_bins %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% summarise(Bin = 0) -> first_bin_per_chrom

# Add the first bin to the RI_missing_bins dataframe
RI_missing_bins %>% bind_rows(first_bin_per_chrom) -> RI_missing_bins

# Filter to exclude the Y chromosome and chrM
RI_missing_bins %>% filter(CHROM != "chrY" & CHROM != "chrM") -> RI_missing_bins

# Make CHROM a factor sorted by chromosome number
RI_missing_bins$CHROM <- factor(RI_missing_bins$CHROM, levels = paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y")))
```

```{r plot heatmap of RI missingness bins}
# Plot binned RI missing loci along the genome as heatmap
ggplot(RI_missing_bins, aes(x = Bin/1000000, y = CHROM, fill = Number_of_RI_Missing_Loci )) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", na.value = "grey70", begin=0.3, end=0, trans="log10", labels=comma) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Number of RI missing loci") +
  theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill="white"),
  panel.grid.major=element_blank(), #adds major grid lines
  panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), #adds minor grid lines
  panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=1.5, linetype="solid"), #draws a black border around plot
  axis.line=element_blank()
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  # Set background to grey
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey70"))+
  # Facet wrap by chromosome with free scales and not labels, make facet labels bold
  facet_wrap(~CHROM, scales = "free", ncol = 5)+
  # Remove y axis labels
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  # make x axis have minor ticks
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 200, 20), minor_breaks = seq(0, 200, 1))+
  # make legend wider
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"))+
  # remove the little minor white lines in the background
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())->RI_missing_bins_heatmap

# Save the plot
ggsave("RI_missing_bins_heatmap.png", RI_missing_bins_heatmap, width=26, height=4.1, dpi=600)

# Save Robject
saveRDS(RI_missing_bins_heatmap, "RI_missing_bins_heatmap.rds")
```
